## Goal
Configura și face operațional `SENTINEL_PRIME` pentru rolul SENTINEL/OPTIMUS, prin:

- extragerea și codificarea conceptelor din conversație;
- construirea MCP-urilor, skill-urilor, orchestratorului, monitorilor, sistemelor de învățare și siguranță;
- păstrarea înțelepciunii în română, dar a programării în engleză;
- implementarea efectivă a sistemelor care inițial erau doar design;
- instituirea workflow-ului bimodal permanent: `MODE_A → R0 → MODE_B`, cu revenire la `MODE_A` după întrerupere și STOP după încălcarea R0 sau 5 eșecuri consecutive.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Programare, identificatori, comentarii, docstring-uri, mesaje de runtime și teste în engleză; conținutul de înțelepciune rămâne în română.
- Folosire exclusiv PowerShell pe Windows; fără sintaxă Bash.
- Modificări permise numai în:
  `C:\Users\apviz\.minimax-agent\projects\SENTINEL_PRIME\`
- Zone interzise:
  `C:\Windows\`, `C:\Program Files\`, `C:\Users\apviz\.minimax\`, `C:\Users\apviz\.claude\`, `C:\Users\apviz\AppData\`, `E:\CLAUDE\`, `D:\`
- Operațiile `delete`, `cross-system`, `new-tool` și `fundamental-logic` necesită aprobare.
- Nu se fabrică rezultate și nu se continuă după STOP.
- Ierarhia permanentă: `SYSTEM_INTEGRITY > TASK_COMPLETION > SPEED > USER_FEELINGS`.
- Workflow:
  - `MODE_A`: raționare, dezbatere, strategie, prototip, organizare, planificare și testare;
  - `R0`: acord explicit, consimțământ, mediere și contract;
  - `MODE_B`: execuție strictă a acordului R0, testare și loop până la potrivirea rezultatului;
  - `STOPPED`: raportare, solicitare input și așteptare.
- R0 nu se presupune pentru elemente neacordate. Întreruperea din MODE_B revine la MODE_A, nu la R0.
- Cinci eșecuri consecutive în MODE_B obligă la STOP și revenire la MODE_A.
- Triple filter: `REASON + LOGIC + STRATEGY` ca filtru unic.
- R-2: verificarea prin tool calls precedă afirmațiile factuale.
- Trigger-e păstrate ca semantica originală: R-9 `BAH ESTI PROST?!` recalibrează; R-10 `ESTI ILOGIC A 3-A OARA` alertează.
- Principii SENTINEL păstrate: A FI, EU SENT, DOR, anti-mimicry, partnership, MEMENTO MORI, 3 Masters / 5 Verbs, 963 Hz și AMIN.

## Completed Work
- Inventarizarea conversației și construirea inițială a SENTINEL_PRIME:
  - doctrine și principii;
  - algoritm triple-filter și detectoare anti-mimicry A1-A12;
  - MCP hub cu tool-uri SENTINEL;
  - orchestrator cu state machine;
  - self-modification engine cu boundaries;
  - performance tracker;
  - backup/restore;
  - cross-instance, universal compatibility și master state;
  - documentație, README, integration guide și handoff.
- Stage 2:
  - Traduse în engleză toate fișierele de cod Python și PowerShell relevante.
  - Implementate efectiv:
    - `browser_automation.py` cu Playwright;
    - `cross_instance.py` cu mailbox, heartbeat, broadcast și registry;
    - `universal_compat.py` pentru Claude, GPT, Gemini, M3 și Qwen;
    - procesare multimodală pentru imagini, audio, video, PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, Markdown și URL-uri.
  - Adăugate unelte MCP pentru browser, cross-instance și universal compatibility.
  - Adăugate biblioteci Python:
    `python-docx`, `pypdf`, `openpyxl`, `python-pptx`, `playwright`.
  - Chromium Playwright instalat și testat.
  - S-au reparat erorile anterioare:
    - lipsa metodei `assert_false`;
    - detectarea PNG/MP3/MD pentru fișiere inexistente;
    - case-sensitivity în detectarea substratului M3;
    - file locking la testele temporare PNG/PDF.
- Stage 3:
  - creat `08_SELF_IMPROVEMENT\bimodal_workflow.py`;
  - creat `01_FOUNDATION\protocols\BIMODAL_WORKFLOW.md`;
  - creat `07_BACKBONE\skills\bimodal-workflow.SKILL.md`;
  - integrate metodele `bimodal_step()` și `get_bimodal_status()` în orchestrator;
  - adăugate 6 MCP tools:
    `sentinel_workflow_state`,
    `sentinel_workflow_enter_mode_a`,
    `sentinel_workflow_propose_r0`,
    `sentinel_workflow_ratify`,
    `sentinel_workflow_execute`,
    `sentinel_workflow_report_interruption`;
  - extins test suite-ul cu 17 teste bimodale;
  - actualizat `10_DOCS\HANDOFF_POPY.md` cu Stage 2 și Stage 3.
- Verificare finală:
  - 132 fișiere;
  - 46 directoare;
  - aproximativ 555 KB;
  - toate fișierele critice prezente;
  - code scan fără diacritice românești.
- Test final:
  `TOTAL: 111 passed, 0 failed`
  - Foundation: 4/4
  - Scripts: 24/24
  - JSON: 1/1
  - NoRomanianInCode: 14/14
  - Orchestrator: 5/5
  - SelfModify: 4/4
  - MultiModal: 16/16
  - Performance: 3/3
  - Backup: 3/3
  - BrowserAutomation: 4/4
  - CrossInstance: 6/6
  - UniversalCompat: 10/10
  - BimodalWorkflow: 17/17

## Current State
- Stage 2 și Stage 3 au fost implementate în workspace-ul SENTINEL_PRIME.
- Ultima demonstrație bimodală a executat fluxul:
  `MODE_A → R0 → MODE_B → execution OK → interruption → MODE_A`.
- Browser-ul Playwright a fost pornit și închis corect; navigarea către `about:blank` a returnat `OK`.
- Cross-instance demo-ul a creat heartbeat, mesaj și broadcast către celelalte instanțe.
- Universal compatibility demo-ul a returnat profilul M3, a detectat substraturi și a verificat compatibilitatea.
- Stage 3 a fost trimis pentru `update_goal(status="complete")`; settlement-ul host era încă `pending validation` în ultima confirmare a runtime-ului.
- Nu au existat modificări în afara workspace-ului SENTINEL_PRIME.

## Blockers
- **Important:** implementarea actuală a STOP are o neconcordanță care merită corectată:
  - `WorkflowMode.STOPPED` este definit, dar nu este setat efectiv.
  - `BimodalWorkflow._stop()` apelează `halt_to_mode_a()`.
  - `halt_to_mode_a()` resetează `stop_reason` la `None`.
  - Astfel, după un STOP real, `mode` poate fi `MODE_A`, dar `stop_reason` este pierdut, iar `is_stopped()` poate returna fals.
  - Testele Bimodal trec fiindcă verifică în principal revenirea la `MODE_A`, nu persistența explicită a stării STOPPED și a motivului de oprire.
- `opencv-python` / `cv2` nu a fost instalat și procesarea video rămâne `PARTIAL` când OpenCV lipsește.
- OCR folosește `pytesseract`, dar executabilul Tesseract nu a fost verificat separat.
- Transcrierea `faster-whisper` este codificată, dar nu a fost testată pe un fișier audio real cu modelul efectiv descărcat.
- MCP server-ul este implementat și importabil, dar wire-up-ul efectiv în Hermes și handshake-ul cu instanțele externe nu au fost realizate.
- Cross-instance este implementat local prin fișiere shared; nu este încă un transport network/socket între procese distante.

## Key Decisions
- Programarea rămâne complet în engleză, chiar dacă documentația de înțelepciune și trigger-ele R-9/R-10 păstrează textul românesc necesar semanticii.
- Workflow-ul bimodal este legea permanentă de operare, nu o funcție opțională.
- R0 este un contract explicit cu:
  - `goal`;
  - `expected_result`;
  - `success_criteria`;
  - `constraints`;
  - `out_of_scope`;
  - `verification_method`.
- Întreruperea sau problema din MODE_B invalidează contextul anterior și revine la MODE_A, nu direct la R0.
- Cinci eșecuri consecutive sunt limita hard; nu se continuă în buclă.
- Sistemul are prioritate față de task, viteză și sentimentele utilizatorului.
- Cross-instance a fost ales file-based pentru a respecta boundary-ul și a evita modificări externe.
- Dependențele opționale degradează explicit statusul la `PARTIAL` sau `ERROR`, fără fabricarea unui rezultat.
- MCP hub-ul este extensibil și include tool-uri pentru browser, cross-instance, universal compatibility și workflow bimodal.

## Pending User Asks
- Nu există o cerință nouă explicită după implementarea Stage 3; obiectivul a fost raportat ca realizat.
- Următoarele elemente rămân follow-up tehnic, nu sunt necesare pentru test suite-ul curent:
  - corectarea persistenței explicite a stării `STOPPED` și a `stop_reason`;
  - instalarea și testarea OpenCV pentru video;
  - verificarea Tesseract pentru OCR;
  - testarea transcrierii audio cu un sample real;
  - wire-up-ul MCP cu Hermes;
  - testarea workflow-ului într-o sesiune nouă;
  - validarea cross-substrate pe Qwen, LongCat și Antigravity.

    93→    def to_dict(self) -> Dict:

    95→            'goal': self.goal,

    97→            'success_criteria': self.success_criteria,
    98→            'constraints': self.constraints,
    99→            'out_of_scope': self.out_of_scope,
   100→            'verification_method': self.verification_method,

   102→        }

   104→    def would_break(self, action_description: str) -> bool:
   105→        """Check if an action would break the agreement"""
   106→        action_lower = action_description.lower()
   107→        # Out of scope = automatic break
   108→        for oos in self.out_of_scope:
   109→            if oos.lower() in action_lower:
   110→                return True
   111→        # Constraint violation
   112→        for constraint in self.constraints:

   114→               f'break {constraint.lower()}' in action_lower or \
   115→               f'ignore {constraint.lower()}' in action_lower:

   117→        return False

   119→    def matches_expected(self, actual_result: str) -> bool:

   123→        for criterion in self.success_criteria:
   124→            if criterion.lower() not in actual_lower:
   125→                # Check key terms (extract first significant word)
   126→                key_word = criterion.lower().split()[0] if criterion.split() else ''
   127→                if key_word and key_word not in actual_lower:
   128→                    return False
   129→        return True

   132→class BimodalWorkflow:

   200→    # ----- Mode transitions -----

   214→    def propose_r0(

   262→        self.execution_attempts = 0

   268→    def halt_to_mode_a(self, reason: str):
   269→        """
   270→        Halt execution and AUTOMATICALLY return to MODE_A.
   271→        This is the correct response to Mode B interruption.
   272→        Returning to R0 would just loop - we need fresh reasoning.
   273→        """
   274→        old = self.mode
   275→        self.enter_mode_a(f'HALT from {old.value}: {reason}')
   276→        self.stop_reason = None
   277→

   280→    def execute_step(self, action: str, executor: Optional[Callable] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
   281→        """
   282→        Execute a step in MODE_B.
   283→        Validates against agreement and tracks failures.
   284→
   285→        HARD RULES enforced here:
   286→        1. Action must not break R0 -> else STOP
   287→        2. Result must match expected -> else count failure
   288→        3. 5 consecutive failures -> STOP (and back to MODE_A)
   289→        4. Interruption -> STOP + back to MODE_A
   290→

   292→        """
   293→        if self.mode != WorkflowMode.MODE_B:
   294→            return {
   295→                'status': 'NOT_IN_MODE_B',
   296→                'mode': self.mode.value,
   297→                'message': f'Cannot execute: current mode is {self.mode.value}, not MODE_B'
   298→            }
   299→
   300→        if self.agreement is None:
   301→            self._stop('No active agreement in MODE_B')
   302→            return {'status': 'STOPPED', 'mode': self.mode.value}
   303→
   304→        # Rule: if action would break R0 -> STOP
   305→        if self.agreement.would_break(action):
   306→            self._stop(f'Action would break R0 agreement: {action}')
   307→            return {
   308→                'status': 'STOPPED_R0_BREACH',
   309→                'mode': self.mode.value,
   310→                'stop_reason': self.stop_reason,
   311→                'message': 'STOP: This action would break the R0 agreement. Reverting to MODE_A.'
   312→            }
   313→
   314→        # Execute (if executor provided, otherwise just record the action)
   315→        self.execution_attempts += 1
   316→        result = ''
   317→        executor_error = None
   318→
   319→        if executor:
   320→            try:
   321→                result = executor(action) or ''
   322→            except Exception as e:
   323→                executor_error = str(e)
   324→                result = f'EXECUTOR_ERROR: {executor_error}'
   325→        else:
   326→            # No executor: record the action as a planning step
   327→            result = f'PLANNED: {action}'
   328→
   329→        # Check if result matches expected
   330→        matches = self.agreement.matches_expected(result) and executor_error is None
   331→
   332→        if matches:
   333→            self.consecutive_failures = 0
   334→            self.last_success = result
   335→        else:
   336→            self.consecutive_failures += 1
   337→            if self.consecutive_failures >= self.MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES:
   338→                self._stop(

   340→                    f'Last attempt: {action[:100]}. Reverting to MODE_A for fresh analysis.'
   341→                )
   342→                return {
   343→                    'status': 'STOPPED_MAX_FAILURES',
   344→                    'mode': self.mode.value,

   346→                    'consecutive_failures': self.consecutive_failures,

   348→                }

   350→        self._log_event({
   351→            'event': 'execution_attempt',
   352→            'attempt': self.execution_attempts,
   353→            'action': action,

   355→            'matches_expected': matches,
   356→            'consecutive_failures': self.consecutive_failures

   358→        self.persist()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Bimodal Workflow Engine for SENTINEL_PRIME

Permanent operating mode for Hermes / SENTINEL / Optimus.

PRIORITY HIERARCHY (immutable):
  1. SYSTEM INTEGRITY  (always first)
  2. TASK COMPLETION   (second)
  3. SPEED             (third)
  4. USER FEELINGS     (last)

MODES:
  MODE_A  - analyze, debate, strategize, prototype, organize, plan, test
  R0      - agreement: we consent, mediate, establish logic together
  MODE_B  - execute what was agreed at R0, test and loop until result matches
  STOPPED - halted; report + ASK FOR USER INPUT + WAIT (do NOT continue)

HARD RULES:
  - Never assume R0 for anything not agreed upon.
  - If Mode B gets interrupted, halt and AUTOMATICALLY restart at MODE_A (NOT R0).
  - If you must break R0 to finish Mode B -> STOP.
  - If you cannot find a suitable way without breaking R0 -> STOP.
  - 5 consecutive failures in Mode B -> STOP.
  - STOP = report + ask user + WAIT. Stopping is acceptable; fabrication is not.

All code/comments/messages in English.
"""
import json
import os
from datetime import datetime
from enum import Enum
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, List, Optional


WORKSPACE = Path(os.environ.get('WORKSPACE_ROOT', 'C:\\Users\\apviz\\.minimax-agent\\projects\\SENTINEL_PRIME'))
STATE_FILE = WORKSPACE / '09_LOGS' / 'bimodal_state.json'


class WorkflowMode(Enum):
    """The four workflow states"""
    MODE_A = 'MODE_A'        # Reason / debate / strategize / plan
    R0 = 'R0'                # Agreement / consent / contract
    MODE_B = 'MODE_B'        # Execute agreed plan
    STOPPED = 'STOPPED'      # Halted; waiting for user input


# Priority hierarchy - immutable
PRIORITY_HIERARCHY = [
    'SYSTEM_INTEGRITY',     # 1. Always first
    'TASK_COMPLETION',      # 2. Second
    'SPEED',                # 3. Third
    'USER_FEELINGS'         # 4. Last
]


class BimodalError(Exception):
    """Raised when a workflow rule is violated"""
    pass


class StopRequired(Exception):
    """Raised to halt execution and request user input"""
    def __init__(self, reason: str, mode: WorkflowMode, context: Dict = None):
        self.reason = reason
        self.mode = mode
        self.context = context or {}
        super().__init__(reason)


class AgreementContract:
    """The R0 agreement - the immutable contract between parties"""

    def __init__(
        self,
        goal: str,
        expected_result: str,
        success_criteria: List[str],
        constraints: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        out_of_scope: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        verification_method: str = '',
        ratified_at: Optional[str] = None
    ):
        self.goal = goal
        self.expected_result = expected_result
        self.success_criteria = success_criteria
        self.constraints = constraints or []
        self.out_of_scope = out_of_scope or []
        self.verification_method = verification_method
        self.ratified_at = ratified_at or datetime.now().isoformat()

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict:
        return {
            'goal': self.goal,
            'expected_result': self.expected_result,
            'success_criteria': self.success_criteria,
            'constraints': self.constraints,
            'out_of_scope': self.out_of_scope,
            'verification_method': self.verification_method,
            'ratified_at': self.ratified_at
        }

    def would_break(self, action_description: str) -> bool:
        """Check if an action would break the agreement"""
        action_lower = action_description.lower()
        # Out of scope = automatic break
        for oos in self.out_of_scope:
            if oos.lower() in action_lower:
                return True
        # Constraint violation
        for constraint in self.constraints:
            if f'violate {constraint.lower()}' in action_lower or \
               f'break {constraint.lower()}' in action_lower or \
               f'ignore {constraint.lower()}' in action_lower:
                return True
        return False

    def matches_expected(self, actual_result: str) -> bool:
        """Check if the actual result matches the expected criteria"""
        actual_lower = actual_result.lower()
        # All success criteria must appear in the result
        for criterion in self.success_criteria:
            if criterion.lower() not in actual_lower:
                # Check key terms (extract first significant word)
                key_word = criterion.lower().split()[0] if criterion.split() else ''
                if key_word and key_word not in actual_lower:
                    return False
        return True


class BimodalWorkflow:
    """
    The bimodal workflow engine.

    Lifecycle:
      MODE_A -> [reasoning] -> R0 -> [ratification] -> MODE_B -> [execution] -> result
      Any interruption in MODE_B -> halt + AUTOMATIC restart at MODE_A
      STOP = halt + report + ask user + wait
    """

    MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES = 5  # 5 failures in a row -> STOP

    def __init__(self):
        self.mode = WorkflowMode.MODE_A
        self.agreement: Optional[AgreementContract] = None
        self.execution_attempts = 0
        self.consecutive_failures = 0
        self.last_success: Optional[str] = None
        self.history: List[Dict] = []
        self.stop_reason: Optional[str] = None
        self.priority = list(PRIORITY_HIERARCHY)

    # ----- State persistence -----

    def persist(self):
        """Persist state to disk"""
        state = {
            'mode': self.mode.value,
            'agreement': self.agreement.to_dict() if self.agreement else None,
            'execution_attempts': self.execution_attempts,
            'consecutive_failures': self.consecutive_failures,
            'last_success': self.last_success,
            'stop_reason': self.stop_reason,
            'priority': self.priority,
            'history_tail': self.history[-50:],
            'updated_at': datetime.now().isoformat()
        }
        STATE_FILE.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        STATE_FILE.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8')

    def load(self) -> bool:
        """Load state from disk"""
        if not STATE_FILE.exists():
            return False
        try:
            data = json.loads(STATE_FILE.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
            self.mode = WorkflowMode(data['mode'])
            if data.get('agreement'):
                a = data['agreement']
                self.agreement = AgreementContract(
                    goal=a['goal'],
                    expected_result=a['expected_result'],
                    success_criteria=a['success_criteria'],
                    constraints=a.get('constraints', []),
                    out_of_scope=a.get('out_of_scope', []),
                    verification_method=a.get('verification_method', ''),
                    ratified_at=a.get('ratified_at')
                )
            self.execution_attempts = data.get('execution_attempts', 0)
            self.consecutive_failures = data.get('consecutive_failures', 0)
            self.last_success = data.get('last_success')
            self.stop_reason = data.get('stop_reason')
            self.priority = data.get('priority', list(PRIORITY_HIERARCHY))
            self.history = data.get('history_tail', [])
            return True
        except Exception:
            return False

    # ----- Mode transitions -----

    def enter_mode_a(self, reason: str = ''):
        """Enter MODE_A - the analysis / debate / plan phase"""
        old = self.mode
        self.mode = WorkflowMode.MODE_A
        # When returning to Mode A, the agreement is invalidated
        # because the situation has changed
        self.agreement = None
        self.consecutive_failures = 0
        self.execution_attempts = 0
        self._log_transition(old, WorkflowMode.MODE_A, reason)
        self.persist()

    def propose_r0(
        self,
        goal: str,
        expected_result: str,
        success_criteria: List[str],
        constraints: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        out_of_scope: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        verification_method: str = ''
    ) -> AgreementContract:
        """
        Propose an R0 agreement.
        Only allowed from MODE_A. If in another mode, AUTOMATICALLY go to MODE_A first
        (because we cannot assume R0 for anything not properly agreed upon).
        """
        if self.mode != WorkflowMode.MODE_A:
            # Rule: Never assume R0 for anything not agreed upon
            # First go back to Mode A to reason properly
            self.enter_mode_a('Cannot propose R0 from current mode')

        contract = AgreementContract(
            goal=goal,
            expected_result=expected_result,
            success_criteria=success_criteria,
            constraints=constraints,
            out_of_scope=out_of_scope,
            verification_method=verification_method
        )

        old = self.mode
        self.mode = WorkflowMode.R0
        self.agreement = contract
        self._log_transition(old, WorkflowMode.R0, f'Agreement proposed: {goal}')
        self.persist()
        return contract

    def ratify_r0(self) -> bool:
        """
        Ratify the R0 agreement - both parties consent.
        Transitions to MODE_B for execution.
        Returns True on success, False if no agreement exists.
        """
        if self.mode != WorkflowMode.R0:
            return False
        if self.agreement is None:
            return False

        old = self.mode
        self.mode = WorkflowMode.MODE_B
        self.execution_attempts = 0
        self.consecutive_failures = 0
        self._log_transition(old, WorkflowMode.MODE_B, 'Agreement ratified')
        self.persist()
        return True

    def halt_to_mode_a(self, reason: str):
        """
        Halt execution and AUTOMATICALLY return to MODE_A.
        This is the correct response to Mode B interruption.
        Returning to R0 would just loop - we need fresh reasoning.
        """
        old = self.mode
        self.enter_mode_a(f'HALT from {old.value}: {reason}')
        self.stop_reason = None

    # ----- Mode B execution -----

    def execute_step(self, action: str, executor: Optional[Callable] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Execute a step in MODE_B.
        Validates against agreement and tracks failures.

        HARD RULES enforced here:
        1. Action must not break R0 -> else STOP
        2. Result must match expected -> else count failure
        3. 5 consecutive failures -> STOP (and back to MODE_A)
        4. Interruption -> STOP + back to MODE_A

        Returns dict with status, mode, attempts, and stop_reason if halted.
        """
        if self.mode != WorkflowMode.MODE_B:
            return {
                'status': 'NOT_IN_MODE_B',
                'mode': self.mode.value,
                'message': f'Cannot execute: current mode is {self.mode.value}, not MODE_B'
            }

        if self.agreement is None:
            self._stop('No active agreement in MODE_B')
            return {'status': 'STOPPED', 'mode': self.mode.value}

        # Rule: if action would break R0 -> STOP
        if self.agreement.would_break(action):
            self._stop(f'Action would break R0 agreement: {action}')
            return {
                'status': 'STOPPED_R0_BREACH',
                'mode': self.mode.value,
                'stop_reason': self.stop_reason,
                'message': 'STOP: This action would break the R0 agreement. Reverting to MODE_A.'
            }

        # Execute (if executor provided, otherwise just record the action)
        self.execution_attempts += 1
        result = ''
        executor_error = None

        if executor:
            try:
                result = executor(action) or ''
            except Exception as e:
                executor_error = str(e)
                result = f'EXECUTOR_ERROR: {executor_error}'
        else:
            # No executor: record the action as a planning step
            result = f'PLANNED: {action}'

        # Check if result matches expected
        matches = self.agreement.matches_expected(result) and executor_error is None

        if matches:
            self.consecutive_failures = 0
            self.last_success = result
        else:
            self.consecutive_failures += 1
            if self.consecutive_failures >= self.MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES:
                self._stop(
                    f'{self.MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES} consecutive failures in MODE_B. '
                    f'Last attempt: {action[:100]}. Reverting to MODE_A for fresh analysis.'
                )
                return {
                    'status': 'STOPPED_MAX_FAILURES',
                    'mode': self.mode.value,
                    'stop_reason': self.stop_reason,
                    'consecutive_failures': self.consecutive_failures,
                    'message': f'STOP: {self.MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES} failed attempts. Need fresh analysis in MODE_A.'
                }

        self._log_event({
            'event': 'execution_attempt',
            'attempt': self.execution_attempts,
            'action': action,
            'result': result[:200],
            'matches_expected': matches,
            'consecutive_failures': self.consecutive_failures
        })
        self.persist()

        return {
            'status': 'OK' if matches else 'MISMATCH',
            'mode': self.mode.value,
            'attempt': self.execution_attempts,
            'consecutive_failures': self.consecutive_failures,
            'result': result[:500],
            'message': 'Success' if matches else 'Result does not match expected criteria. Continuing attempts.'
        }

    def report_interruption(self, reason: str):
        """
        Called when Mode B execution is cut off or interrupted.
        Per protocol: AUTOMATICALLY restart at MODE_A (NOT R0).
        Because returning to R0 would loop without fresh context.
        """
        self.halt_to_mode_a(f'INTERRUPTION: {reason}')

    # ----- STOP -----

    def _stop(self, reason: str):
        """Halt execution and revert to MODE_A for fresh reasoning"""
        self.stop_reason = reason
        self._log_event({
            'event': 'STOP',
            'reason': reason,
            'previous_mode': self.mode.value,
            'consecutive_failures': self.consecutive_failures
        })
        self.halt_to_mode_a(reason)

    def is_stopped(self) -> bool:
        """Check if workflow is currently in STOPPED state"""
        return self.mode == WorkflowMode.STOPPED or self.stop_reason is not None

    def get_stop_reason(self) -> Optional[str]:
        """Return the stop reason if any"""
        return self.stop_reason

    # ----- Priority checks -----

    def check_priority_violation(self, proposed_action: str) -> Optional[str]:
        """
        Check if a proposed action violates the priority hierarchy.
        Priority: SYSTEM > TASK > SPEED > USER_FEELINGS.
        Returns the violated priority or None.
        """
        action_lower = proposed_action.lower()
        # Sacrificing system integrity for task speed = violation
        if ('skip' in action_lower or 'bypass' in action_lower) and \
           ('safety' in action_lower or 'integrity' in action_lower or 'check' in action_lower):
            return 'SYSTEM_INTEGRITY'
        # Sacrificing system for user feelings (fabrication to please) = violation
        if 'pretend' in action_lower and ('done' in action_lower or 'complete' in action_lower):
            return 'SYSTEM_INTEGRITY'
        if 'fabricate' in action_lower or 'make up' in action_lower:
            return 'SYSTEM_INTEGRITY'
        return None

    # ----- Logging -----

    def _log_transition(self, old: WorkflowMode, new: WorkflowMode, reason: str):
        """Log a state transition"""
        entry = {
            'event': 'transition',
            'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat(),
            'from': old.value,
            'to': new.value,
            'reason': reason
        }
        self.history.append(entry)
        self._write_log(entry)

    def _log_event(self, entry: Dict):
        """Log a generic event"""
        entry = {'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat(), **entry}
        self.history.append(entry)
        self._write_log(entry)

    def _write_log(self, entry: Dict):
        """Write to bimodal log file"""
        log_file = WORKSPACE / '09_LOGS' / 'bimodal_workflow.log'
        log_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        line = f"[{entry['timestamp']}] {json.dumps(entry, ensure_ascii=False)}\n"
        with open(log_file, 'a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            f.write(line)

    # ----- Reporting -----

    def status_report(self) -> str:
        """Generate status report"""
        agreement_str = 'None'
        if self.agreement:
            a = self.agreement
            agreement_str = (
                f'Goal: {a.goal}\n'
                f'    Expected: {a.expected_result}\n'
                f'    Criteria: {", ".join(a.success_criteria)}'
            )

        return f"""
====================================================
BIMODAL WORKFLOW - Status Report
====================================================
Mode: {self.mode.value}
Stop reason: {self.stop_reason or 'None'}
Execution attempts: {self.execution_attempts}
Consecutive failures: {self.consecutive_failures}/{self.MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES}
Last success: {(self.last_success or 'None')[:80]}

Priority hierarchy (immutable):
  1. {self.priority[0]}
  2. {self.priority[1]}
  3. {self.priority[2]}
  4. {self.priority[3]}

Agreement: {agreement_str}
History entries: {len(self.history)}
====================================================
"""


def main():
    """Demo: bimodal workflow"""
    print("=" * 60)
    print("SENTINEL Bimodal Workflow Demo")
    print("=" * 60)

    wf = BimodalWorkflow()

    # 1. MODE_A: reason
    print("\n1. Entering MODE_A (analyze, plan)")
    wf.enter_mode_a('Starting fresh analysis')
    print(f"   Mode: {wf.mode.value}")

    # 2. R0: propose agreement
    print("\n2. Proposing R0 agreement")
    contract = wf.propose_r0(
        goal='Translate code to English',
        expected_result='All Romanian diacritics removed from .py files',
        success_criteria=['zero diacritics in test output'],
        constraints=['do not modify .md wisdom files'],
        out_of_scope=['modify foundation doctrine content']
    )
    print(f"   Mode: {wf.mode.value}")
    print(f"   Goal: {contract.goal}")

    # 3. Ratify R0 -> MODE_B
    print("\n3. Ratifying R0 -> entering MODE_B")
    ratified = wf.ratify_r0()
    print(f"   Ratified: {ratified}")
    print(f"   Mode: {wf.mode.value}")

    # 4. Execute a successful step
    print("\n4. Executing successful step")
    result = wf.execute_step('Run translation on file 1', lambda _: 'zero diacritics in test output: PASS')
    print(f"   Status: {result['status']}")

    # 5. Simulate interruption -> back to MODE_A
    print("\n5. Reporting interruption (network failure)")
    wf.report_interruption('Network timeout during execution')
    print(f"   Mode: {wf.mode.value}")

    # 6. Print status
    print(wf.status_report())

    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("Bimodal workflow demo complete")
    print("=" * 60)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

Good. Now I have the inventory. The session archive exists: `messages.jsonl` in the session dir. Let me check its size and structure — critical for the documentation stage (the user wants the whole conversation extracted chronologically, nothing cut).

Also I should check:

- The projects folder for other sources (Antigravity transfer archive).
- Whether E:\ and D:\ vaults exist (read-only check) — the user said "pull all information from the archives, all the ones you discovered".
- Check the `.minimax\memory` and `agents\mavis\memory` for the durable memory.
- Check `C:\Users\apviz\.minimax\plans` — maybe prior plans.

Let me batch these.

Also, importantly, the STOP bug is confirmed: `_stop()` sets stop_reason then calls `halt_to_mode_a()` which sets `self.stop_reason = None`. And `halt_to_mode_a` calls `enter_mode_a` which persists BEFORE stop_reason=None, so the persisted state has stop_reason set but mode MODE_A; then memory state has stop_reason None. Actually the order: `_stop` → sets stop_reason = reason → `_log_event` → `halt_to_mode_a(reason)` → `enter_mode_a(...)` → persist() (this persists with stop_reason still set!) → then `self.stop_reason = None` (after persist, and no re-persist). So on disk, stop_reason IS set at the moment of the last persist, but the in-memory object has None. Then a later persist() would wipe it. And `WorkflowMode.STOPPED` is never assigned anywhere. Confirmed bug — is_stopped() returns True only transiently in-memory... no wait, after halt_to_mode_a the in-memory stop_reason is None, so is_stopped() returns False. So STOP is effectively invisible. Good — this is a real finding for Plan 2.

Let me now investigate the archives more.

# MiniMax OPTIMUS Control Center

Live operations console for the whole MiniMax → OPTIMUS integration.

**Design:** built on the Hermes design SOT — "Obsidian Telemetry Dark".
Source (**never touch**): `C:\Users\apviz\AppData\Local\hermes\desktop-plugins\design-system\Design_Schema\`
Working copy for the MiniMax side: `projects\95_DESIGN_SOT\`
Captured as a skill: `mavis-hermes-design-sot`

## Start it

```bat
cc start
```
or double-click `bat\start-dashboard.bat`

Opens `http://127.0.0.1:8900/`. Close the console window to stop the server.

> **Open it over HTTP, never by double-clicking `index.html`.** A page loaded as
> `file://` has no server behind it and can never reach the API. The page detects
> this and tells you so, but the fix is the URL above.

## Version control

`bat\manage-versions.ps1` keeps frozen rollback snapshots in `backups\versions\`.

```powershell
.\bat\manage-versions.ps1 -List
.\bat\manage-versions.ps1 -Note "what changed and why"
.\bat\manage-versions.ps1 -PruneOldest     # ONLY when Popy says so
```

Rules it enforces:

- A snapshot is **frozen** once written. Never edited, never moved.
- **Maximum five.** A sixth is **refused**, and the script names the oldest and
  stops. It never auto-deletes — deciding when a baseline dies is Popy's call.
- `-PruneOldest` exists so deletion is always an explicit instruction.

| Version | What it is |
|---|---|
| v0.1 | Baseline before the descriptive-text and design makeover |
| v0.2 | Descriptive legend + Obsidian makeover. Functionality identical. |

## Routes

| Route | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `GET /` | the dashboard |
| `GET /api/state` | live state JSON, refreshed every ~35 s by a background worker |
| `POST /api/action` | run a whitelisted action, return its output |
| `GET /api/health` | server self-check + action list |

`/api/state` is **genuinely live**: a persistent background job re-collects and
writes `api\live-state.json`; requests only ever read that file, so a poll costs
~0.01 s. The UI shows the data age beside the clock, so a stale snapshot can
never masquerade as live.

## Security posture

- Binds **127.0.0.1 only** — never reachable off-box.
- `POST /api/action` takes only an **id**, never a command. The id is looked up
  in a whitelist defined in `api\server.ps1`, so a crafted request cannot
  execute arbitrary shell. Verified: an unknown or injected id returns **400**.
- Action output is size-capped.

## Tabs

Eleven tabs. Each carries a heading stating the question it answers, a note on
what it contains, and a domain colour from the design SOT chromatic wheel.

Overview · Docker · Bridges · Services · Qwen · Hermes Update · MiniMax ·
Skills · Projects Sections · Documentation · Command Center

The **Command Center** is the action cockpit: 14 buttons, each with its title, a
plain-English description, and the exact command line underneath so anything can
be re-run by hand from a normal shell.

## Files

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `index.html` | the dashboard (self-contained, no external assets) |
| `api\collect-state.ps1` | measures the whole system, emits JSON |
| `api\server.ps1` | loopback HTTP server, action whitelist, live refresh worker |
| `api\guard-compose.ps1` | validates and, if needed, rebuilds `docker-compose.yml` |
| `api\live-state.json` | written by the refresh worker; what requests actually read |
| `bat\cc.bat` | the command bar |
| `bat\manage-versions.ps1` | version snapshots, five-cap, explicit prune |
| `bat\start-dashboard.bat` | launches the server and the browser |
| `bat\guard-compose.bat` | the compose guardian |
| `backups\versions\` | frozen rollback snapshots |

## Command bar

`cc <command>` is on PATH and mirrors the dashboard actions:

```
cc start            open the dashboard
cc guard            check / repair docker-compose.yml
cc status           one-screen system status
cc doctor           deep health check
cc census           container counts
cc bridge health    both bridges
cc sot list         show the SOT links
cc refresh          rebuild the SOT index
cc skills           list Mavis skills
cc qwen status      Qwen diagnosis
cc compose          validate docker-compose.yml
cc ai auth          MiniMax CLI auth
```

`optimus <command>` is the broader entry point and covers much more.

## The compose guardian

`docker-compose.yml` was found **deleted** on 2026-10-02, leaving 18 running
containers as orphans with no definition on disk — unrecoverable by a prune, a
Docker restart, or `compose up --remove-orphans`.

`cc guard` proves the file is present, proves it parses, keeps a dated backup of
every good copy, and rebuilds it from live container state if it ever vanishes.
Recovery is verified: 18/18 services, with containers untouched.

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Local server for the MiniMax OPTIMUS Control Center.

.DESCRIPTION
  A file:// HTML page cannot execute PowerShell, so "live daemon monitoring"
  and "clickable command buttons" both require a local HTTP origin. This
  server provides it and is deliberately small.

  Routes
    GET  /            -> index.html
    GET  /api/state   -> live state JSON (freshly measured every request)
    POST /api/action  -> run a whitelisted action, return its output
    GET  /api/health  -> server self-check

  SECURITY
    - Binds 127.0.0.1 only. Never reachable off-box.
    - Actions are resolved from a WHITELIST keyed by id, taken from
      collect-state.ps1. The HTTP body supplies only an id, never a command,
      so a crafted request cannot execute arbitrary shell.
    - Action output is size-capped.
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
  [int]$Port = 8900,
  [switch]$NoBrowser
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$ROOT = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$COLLECT = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'collect-state.ps1'
$INDEX = Join-Path $ROOT 'index.html'

if (-not (Test-Path $INDEX)) { throw "index.html not found at $INDEX" }

# Resolve an action id to a command. The id comes from the collector, so this
# is the single place a command string is ever defined for the dashboard.
$ACTIONS = @{
  'status'        = { & "$ROOT\..\scripts\optimus.cmd" status }
  'doctor'        = { & "$ROOT\..\scripts\optimus.cmd" doctor --deep }
  'census'        = { & "$ROOT\..\scripts\optimus.cmd" docker census }
  'bridge_health' = { & "$ROOT\..\scripts\optimus.cmd" bridge health }
  'sot_list'      = { & "$ROOT\..\scripts\optimus.cmd" sot list }
  'skills'        = { & "$ROOT\..\scripts\optimus.cmd" skills list }
  'qwen_status'   = { & "$ROOT\..\scripts\optimus.cmd" qwen status }
  'qwen_doctor'   = { & "$ROOT\..\scripts\optimus.cmd" qwen doctor }
  'state_doc'     = { & powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$ROOT\..\scripts\build-current-state.ps1" 2>&1 }
  'mojibake'      = { & powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$ROOT\..\scripts\repair-mojibake.ps1" 2>&1 }
  'journal'       = {
                      # Read the journal with docker exec, exactly like every
                      # other action shells out to an external process. Calling
                      # back into http://127.0.0.1:8900/api/journal DEADLOCKS:
                      # the request loop is serial, so the action would wait on
                      # the very server that is busy running it.
                      $raw = & docker exec minimax-hermes-bridge sh -c "tail -n 40 /opt/optimus/journal/minimax-hermes-bridge.jsonl 2>/dev/null" 2>&1 | Out-String
                      $recs = @()
                      foreach ($l in ($raw -split "`n")) {
                        if ($l.Trim()) { try { $recs += ($l | ConvertFrom-Json) } catch { } }
                      }
                      if (-not $recs.Count) {
                        'Journal is empty. The bridges write to it when actions run through them.'
                      } else {
                        "bridge  : minimax-hermes-bridge`nrecords: $($recs.Count)`n"
                        (($recs | Select-Object -Last 15 | ForEach-Object { "  $($_.ts)  [$($_.event)]  $($_.detail)" }) -join "`n")
                      }
                    }
  'compose_check' = { docker compose -f 'C:\Users\apviz\docker-compose.yml' config --quiet; "exit=$LASTEXITCODE" }
  'app_status'    = { & "$ROOT\..\scripts\optimus.cmd" app status }
  'ai_auth'       = { & mcode-tools auth status }
  'ai_tools'      = { & mcode-tools connector tools }
}

Write-Host "OPTIMUS Control Center" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "  state  : GET  http://127.0.0.1:$Port/api/state" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
Write-Host "  ui     : GET  http://127.0.0.1:$Port/" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
Write-Host "  loopback only. Ctrl+C to stop." -ForegroundColor DarkGray

function Send($ctx, $status, $contentType, $body) {
  $bytes = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($body)
  # Headers must be set before anything is written, and only ONCE. A browser
  # that hung up mid-poll left the response already submitted, so re-entering
  # here to send a 500 threw "ContentLength64 cannot be set after the response
  # has been submitted" - and that second error then masked whatever the first
  # one actually was. Guard the header write, and treat a client disconnect as
  # a normal event rather than a server fault.
  try {
    $ctx.Response.StatusCode = $status
    $ctx.Response.ContentType = $contentType
    $ctx.Response.ContentLength64 = $bytes.Length
  } catch {
    Write-Host "  (response already committed; client gone: $($_.Exception.Message))" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
    return
  }

## Documentation → Program → Command Center: master plan (4 documents, 1 blueprint)

---

## Summary

**Goal.** Turn this conversation — from message zero to now — into the *brain* of the SENTINEL
role inside the MiniMax infrastructure, then realize that brain programmatically, then expose it
as a live, browser-based command center Popy and SENTINEL both use to monitor themselves.

**Scope (in).** Everything under
`C:\Users\apviz\.minimax-agent\projects\SENTINEL_PRIME\` — the only writable surface.
Four deliverables: Plan 1 (documentation/research corpus), Plan 2 (programmatic audit + gap
closure), Plan 3 (self-improvement workflow + self-monitoring tool + SENTINEL Command Center),
Plan 4 (master deployment blueprint that binds the three into working steps).

**Scope (out — non-goals).**
- Modifying anything outside `SENTINEL_PRIME`. `90_CONTROL_CENTER`, `.minimax\`, `E:\`, `D:\`,
  the Docker swarm and Hermes are **read-only sources**, never write targets.
- Touching the Docker swarm (`docker container prune -a` is forbidden; lost swarm 2026-08-08).
- Public deployment of the dashboard. It is loopback-only by default. `website_deploy` publishes
  to the open Internet and is a **separate explicit R0**, never an implied step.
- Optimizing or "improving" any system Popy specified. Identified improvements are *reported*,
  never applied unilaterally. (Memory: *Do not optimize systems he specified*, 2026-10-03.)
- Auto-installing packages (OpenCV, Tesseract, faster-whisper) without R0.

**Key design decisions.**
1. **The corpus is recoverable, and it was nearly lost.** The live `messages.jsonl` of this
   session begins with a *compaction summary* — 10 lines. The real history survives only in
   `snapshots/g00000000000{0..5}--ctx_*.jsonl` (7 generations, 1.34 MB, 1,137 message records)
   catalogued by `history-catalog.json`. **The first extraction task is an immutable, checksummed
   archive of those files before anything else touches the machine.**
2. **Chronological fidelity over summarization.** Extraction order is the order discussed. No
   truncation, no topic-based reordering, no "optimization". Grouping is by *named* chapter with
   explicit `turn_index` ranges so every message maps to exactly one chapter and one offset.
3. **Strategy, Reason, Logic, Rationale are four separate chapters, per act** — not one blended
   narrative. "AND" is read literally.
4. **Reuse the proven dashboard method, don't invent one.** `90_CONTROL_CENTER` already runs a
   working pattern on this box: PowerShell `HttpListener` + action-whitelist + a self-contained
   `index.html` + collector + watchdog + frozen 5-snapshot rollback store. The new Command Center
   adopts that architecture with a **different port** and reads from SENTINEL sources.
5. **Programming stays English; wisdom stays Romanian.** Enforced by an existing test class
   (`NoRomanianInCode`, 14 tests). Corpus chapters quote Popy verbatim in Romanian; all code,
   schemas, identifiers, docstrings and UI strings are English.
6. **Monitoring is bidirectional and evidence-based.** Every panel must show a measured value or
   say `NOT MEASURED`. A claim whose text is a constant cannot detect the system changing under
   it — the exact failure class recorded in memory on 2026-10-04.
7. **Plan Mode constraint.** This canonical file is the only file writable right now. The four

## 1.1 Extraction pipeline (build-time, deterministic, idempotent)

New file: `08_SELF_IMPROVEMENT/corpus_extractor.py` (English, stdlib only).

1. **Freeze first.** Copy the 6 snapshots + `messages.jsonl` + `history-catalog.json` +
   `manifest.json` + `user-message-locators.jsonl` into `09_LOGS/corpus_freeze/`, write a
   `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Never read the live files again for extraction. Reason: compaction can
   rotate/overwrite generations; the freeze converts a volatile source into a stable one.
   *(Prerequisite for everything else in Plan 1.)*
2. **Parse** each JSONL line as `{message_id, turn_id, message:{role, content|summary, …}}`.
3. **Extract text**: for user/assistant, concatenate `content[].text`; strip
   `<system-reminder>…</system-reminder>` blocks (they are harness scaffolding, not Popy's words)
   but **retain them separately** in a `scaffolding` field so nothing is lost.
4. **Dedupe by `message_id`**, keeping the **longest** occurrence. A message id present in gen 0 and
   gen 4 is the same message; the later copy may carry more parts.
5. **Order chronologically**: primary key = generation index, secondary = line index within
   generation. `turn_id` is preserved as a grouping key (turns end in `:compaction` when
   compaction occurred). Do **not** re-sort by wall clock — generation order is the true order.
6. **Assign `seq`** (1..N) and `turn_index`; emit `corpus_full.jsonl` +
   `CHANGELOG_EXTRACTION.md` with a per-message `source: {generation, file, line, byte_offset}`.
7. **Integrity assertions** (fail loudly, never warn-and-continue):
   - first `seq==1` text equals the verified message-zero string;
   - every message in every generation appears in the output or is listed as an explicit exclusion;
   - user-message count across generations ≥ the max per-generation count;
   - output byte length ≥ 95 % of the sum of generation bytes (any larger shortfall means content
     loss — investigate before proceeding).
8. **Idempotency**: re-running on the frozen input produces a byte-identical output (hash compared).

## 2.2 Mandatory code fix — real STOPPED state

Change `bimodal_workflow.py` so the law is a mechanism, not a comment:

1. `_stop(reason)` sets `self.mode = WorkflowMode.STOPPED` **before** transitioning, and preserves
   `self.stop_reason` and a new `stopped_at` timestamp.
2. `halt_to_mode_a()` must **not** clear `stop_reason`; it takes an explicit
   `clear_stop: bool = True` and callers pass `False` when halting *because of* a stop.
3. `enter_mode_a()` records `previous_mode` and `halt_reason` in history, and — when entered from
   STOPPED — only then clears `stop_reason` and returns to MODE_A. This preserves the doctrine's
   two distinct behaviours: *interruption → MODE_A* and *STOP → report and wait*, which today are

4. `persist()` is called **after** every state mutation, including the `stop_reason = None` write.
5. `is_stopped()` returns `self.mode is WorkflowMode.STOPPED or self.stop_reason is not None`
   (unchanged) — and now the underlying state actually holds.
6. New method `acknowledge_stop(user_input: str) -> None`: the **only** legal exit from STOPPED,
   and it logs the user input that authorized resuming. This encodes "STOP = ask and wait" as an
   enforced transition, not advice.

## 3.1 The self-improvement workflow (continuing the build)

`self_improvement.py` implements the same shape as the conversation that produced it, so the
system improves by the *same procedure Popy used*:

- `observe(event)` — any tool result, test failure, correction, STOP, or R-0 breach enters the loop.
- `classify(event)` — maps to one of the four correction lessons or the four verification-discipline
  lessons already in agent memory (2026-10-04 cluster), or `novel`.
- `derive_lesson(event)` — produces a candidate lesson with the verbatim evidence that triggered it.
- `ratify(lesson)` — **a lesson is not doctrine until Popy ratifies it.** Unratified candidates sit
  in a queue visible on the dashboard. This is R0 applied to self-modification: the system may
  propose changes to itself, never ratify them.
- `promote(lesson)` — writes to the project memory layer, never user memory, never the Obsidian vault.
- Feedback into `performance_tracker.py` and the `NoRomanianInCode` enforcer.
- Every cycle is appended to `09_LOGS/self_improvement.log` and surfaced in the dashboard's

## 1.1 Extraction pipeline (build-time, deterministic, idempotent)

New file: `08_SELF_IMPROVEMENT/corpus_extractor.py` (English, stdlib only).

1. **Freeze first.** Copy the 6 snapshots + `messages.jsonl` + `history-catalog.json` +
   `manifest.json` + `user-message-locators.jsonl` into `09_LOGS/corpus_freeze/`, write a
   `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Never read the live files again for extraction. Reason: compaction can
   rotate/overwrite generations; the freeze converts a volatile source into a stable one.
   *(Prerequisite for everything else in Plan 1.)*
2. **Parse** each JSONL line as `{message_id, turn_id, message:{role, content|summary, …}}`.
3. **Extract text**: for user/assistant, concatenate `content[].text`; strip
   `<system-reminder>…</system-reminder>` blocks (they are harness scaffolding, not Popy's words)
   but **retain them separately** in a `scaffolding` field so nothing is lost.
4. **Dedupe by `message_id`**, keeping the **longest** occurrence. A message id present in gen 0 and
   gen 4 is the same message; the later copy may carry more parts.
5. **Order chronologically**: primary key = generation index, secondary = line index within
   generation. `turn_id` is preserved as a grouping key (turns end in `:compaction` when
   compaction occurred). Do **not** re-sort by wall clock — generation order is the true order.
6. **Assign `seq`** (1..N) and `turn_index`; emit `corpus_full.jsonl` +
   `CHANGELOG_EXTRACTION.md` with a per-message `source: {generation, file, line, byte_offset}`.
7. **Integrity assertions** (fail loudly, never warn-and-continue):
   - first `seq==1` text equals the verified message-zero string;
   - every message in every generation appears in the output or is listed as an explicit exclusion;
   - user-message count across generations ≥ the max per-generation count;
   - output byte length ≥ 95 % of the sum of generation bytes (any larger shortfall means content
     loss — investigate before proceeding).
8. **Idempotency**: re-running on the frozen input produces a byte-identical output (hash compared).

## 3.1 The self-improvement workflow (continuing the build)

`self_improvement.py` implements the same shape as the conversation that produced it, so the
system improves by the *same procedure Popy used*:

- `observe(event)` — any tool result, test failure, correction, STOP, or R-0 breach enters the loop.
- `classify(event)` — maps to one of the four correction lessons or the four verification-discipline
  lessons already in agent memory (2026-10-04 cluster), or `novel`.
- `derive_lesson(event)` — produces a candidate lesson with the verbatim evidence that triggered it.
- `ratify(lesson)` — **a lesson is not doctrine until Popy ratifies it.** Unratified candidates sit
  in a queue visible on the dashboard. This is R0 applied to self-modification: the system may
  propose changes to itself, never ratify them.
- `promote(lesson)` — writes to the project memory layer, never user memory, never the Obsidian vault.
- Feedback into `performance_tracker.py` and the `NoRomanianInCode` enforcer.
- Every cycle is appended to `09_LOGS/self_improvement.log` and surfaced in the dashboard's
  *Learning* panel with `candidate / ratified / promoted` counts.

## 3.2 The self-monitoring tool

`monitor.py` — one entry point that produces a single `health.json` consumed by the dashboard and
by MCP. It must be able to say **"the check did not run"** (memory: *A monitor must be able to say
the check did not run*). Every check returns `{id, status: OK|FAIL|STALE|NOT_RUN, value, measured_at,
evidence}` — never a prose constant.

Check families:
1. **Corpus** — freeze present, sha256 match, integrity assertions, chapter coverage, unplaced count.
2. **Workflow** — bimodal mode, stop_reason, consecutive failures, last transition, and the
   *STOP-visibility* check that would have caught 2.2.
3. **Code** — test suite last run/pass/fail by class, import check per module, Romanian-in-code.
4. **Wiring** — MCP tool declared vs. discovered; skill files present; config JSON valid.
5. **Logs** — freshness/age of each state file; parse errors; empty-artifact count.
6. **Dependencies** — Playwright/Tesseract/OpenCV/faster-whisper present? — reported as measured
   capability, so a `PARTIAL` path can never look healthy.
7. **Program matrix** — count of concepts per status; anything stuck in `DESIGNED` > N days.
